fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole personal watercraft (Yamaha FX Cruiser HO) on its trailer.
findings: Hull and deck look clean and glossy white with no visible chalking or oxidation in the side and front shots
Seats appear clean and bright with no visible staining
Front storage compartment shows some light scuffing and a few water marks on the black liner
Rear mat and swim platform look clean in the stern shot
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the FX Cruiser and it already looks very well kept, with a glossy hull and clean seats. If you want it extra sharp for buyers, we can come to you for a quick wash, wax and wipe-down of the storage compartment. Would you like a quote?
